tei:div.tei:p: 9)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi cha lag gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster bzhugs: na mo pad+ma ka ra ye: dad dang mos gus ldan pa yis: brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol 'debs thabs: byin rlabs dpal ster 'di ru bkod: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: sgo gsum gcig dril dad pa yis: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad brjod: e ma hoḥ kun bzang rdor 'chang rdor sems dga' rab rje: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol te: tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur nas: phrin las phur pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: pra bha hasti pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ye shes mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshogs: bka' drin mtshungs med pad+ma las 'brel la: gsol ba= tshe 'dir= phrin las phur pa= mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum 'khor 'das dang: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can la: gsol ba= tshe 'dir= phrin las phur pa= sa lam mthar phyir yang dag don ldan cing: bskyed rim rnam dag snod bcud lha 10)skur dag: rdzogs rim phyi nang gzhan gsum bcud du smin: rdzogs pa chen po srid zhi mnyam nyid rdzogs: tshe 'dir gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog: ces pa mos gus drag po yis: gsol 'debs 'di la brtson gyur na: byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par nges: the tshom med do sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: ཿ ces bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o/
